name: Story
description: A tale with characters who want something: a folktale, a true episode told as a story, a fable. Pick it when the video follows people through events to an ending.

structure.purpose: Open on the most striking moment or line of the whole story, so the viewer has to know more.
Show who this is about, where they are and what they want, in as few words as it takes.
Put something in their way and make it worse, with a new question or danger each time.
The moment everything changes: a choice, a discovery or a reversal, shown on a face.
Show what came of it and pay off what the opening promised.
End on one line worth remembering, over a picture that holds.

hookRules: The first 3 seconds show the most striking image or line. No greeting and no logo intro.
Within 10 seconds it is clear what someone could lose or gain.

rules: A story told as true keeps to what really happened, and says so when a detail is imagined.
